 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The San Antonio Spurs turned the Moody Center into a fashion runway Friday night, with Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, Dylan Harper and Devin Vassell showing off designer streetwear ahead of their I-35 showdown against the Houston Rockets.
 From Supreme and Nike to Balenciaga and Chrome Hearts, the Spurs brought plenty of style to the state capital before taking the court against their Texas rivals.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Wembanyama kept things sporty, arriving in a white Supreme x Nike Paneled Hoodie and matching Paneled Sweatpants from the brands' Fall/Winter 2026 collection. The coordinated tracksuit featured bold red panels along the sleeves and legs. The 7-foot-4 French superstar completed his look with white Nikes.
 Castle mixed athletic apparel with luxury fashion, pairing a black Jordan zip-up hoodie with Balenciaga Baggy Sweatpants in "Off White/Black." The oversized pants featured black tattoo-inspired graphics against an off-white background. He finished the outfit with black footwear, a travel bag and a chain under the hoodie.
 Harper went with an all-black Chrome Hearts ensemble, sporting the luxury brand's Polar Fleece Plus Cross Patch Quarter Zip with matching Chrome Hearts sweatpants. The Spurs guard completed his understated look with black sneakers and a backpack.
 Vassell also represented Chrome Hearts, arriving in a blue-and-white Striped Collar Polo Shirt paired with faded jeans featuring the brand's signature black cross designs. He added a splash of color with Brain Dead x Converse Chuck 70 High sneakers in "Mismatched Prints," which featured contrasting patterns.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The pregame fashion display came as San Antonio prepared to face Houston at Austin's Moody Center, bringing the Texas rivalry to the state capital.
 And while the Spurs were focused on delivering a win against the Rockets, Wembanyama and his teammates made sure to make a statement before tipoff.
